description: Canonical B/A and Q-values for low isotopes via the paper's 4-input Skein-pair scheme (m_μ/m_e, m_e, μ_u, μ_d) and 4-tier formula. Layer 1: best tier per isotope (D: T1+T4; T/³He: BW+chirality; ⁴He: BW+chirality²+shell; A≥5: BW+shell). Layer 2: Q_β⁻ = Q_β(n) + B_d − B_p where Q_β(n) = m_n − m_p − m_e is exact under the Skein-pair formula. Layer 3: NOT computed (N_v open). All canonical, no fits beyond the 4 structural inputs. p ≠ n via μ_d ≠ μ_u (Δ = μ_d − μ_u captures n-p splitting exactly).

data.calibration_scheme: 4-input Skein-pair (m_μ/m_e, m_e, μ_u, μ_d) per nucleon-mass-splitting-proof.md (commit bd81514)

layer1_b_over_a.tier: trivial (A=1, B=0 by convention; m_atom = m_p + m_e)
layer1_b_over_a.delta_m_shell_method: Bare σ_shell · y_shell from sigma_shell_characterization.py (level-4 self-dual-ILP, summed over A_magic ≤ A). Full Δm_shell with Φ_q amplification deferred — see docs/audits/sigma-shell-categorical-identification.md
layer1_b_over_a.M_atom_pred_method: arithmetic: Z·m_p_CODATA + N·m_n_CODATA + Z·m_e − B (NOT through GB-NF / SDP / knot-ops; uses CODATA scaffold)
layer1_b_over_a.M_atom_tower_method: categorical: m_p from mass-endomorphism tower (1869.85·m_e, 1.84% off), m_n = m_p + Q_β (per calibration-inputs.md), B from 4-tier formula. Fully-derived chain prediction.
